subject: Replace crude first-person arm with vanilla arm model
description: The current hand is three colored cuboids and looks wrong. Rebuild the first-person viewmodel arm as a proper Minecraft 4x12x4-pixel right arm cuboid with correct UV mapping from a player skin texture, correct shoulder pivot, swing animation and held-item placement; fall back to official-steve-like skin if no skin asset exists locally.
